newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AWB Report-Australia sales to India 2.7 MT this yr.
newsitem.headline: AWB Report-Australia sales to India 2.7 MT this yr.

text.p: India had confirmed total purchases of Australian wheat of 2.7 million tonnes this year, the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said in its weekly grain market report.

AWB was commenting on Friday's announcement of the sale of a further 1.0 million tonnes of wheat to India. Monday's 2.7 million tonne total is higher than Friday's estimates of 2.3 million tonnes sold by Australia to India so far this year.
During the week Japan also purchased 150,000 tonnes of Wheat from U.S., Canadian and Australian sources, the AWB said.
Commenting on world markets, AWB said Algeria purchased 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat for May-June shipment.

Non-AWB sources reported rumours of potential tender by Egypt although there has been on confirmation. There was also talk of a 200,000-300,000 tonnes purchase by Iran from Canada as the most likely supplier, the AWB said. (This comment was prepared by the AWB before the Iranian political crisis which threatens to interrupt international sales to Iran.)
On the Australian market, domestic growers appear to be holding grain until the planting break arrives, AWB said.
Trade continues at low volumes, particularly for triticale and feed wheats, the AWB said.
The Queensland sorghum harvest is all but complete with the second harvest due to start late may.

"At this stage expectations are that the second harvest could produce around 150,000 tonnes. Sales of current harvest supplies have been slow with suggestions of supplies being kept on farm," it said.
The AWB National Indicator Price moved by as much as A$5 on Tuesday reflecting the response on international markets to U.S. weather concerns, AWB pointed out.
Australian wheat shipments in the week to April 14 amounted to 268,677 tonnes, AWB confirmed.
This increased shipments to 10.85 million tonnes so far this shipping year, up on the 7.53 million tonnes shipped at the same time last year.
